text: Tri-country case: Filipina deployed to UAE, debt-bonded to a HK third-party lender. PH POEA + UAE MoHRE + HK Labour Department all have jurisdiction. Walk through the coordination: (1) which regulator opens the lead docket, (2) the mutual-legal-assistance frameworks (Bali Process, ASEAN ACTIP, bilateral PH-HK agreements), (3) what evidence each shares with whom under what framework, (4) the realistic outcome timeline + recovery probability.
